_description: Virginia Dragnet v1: curated acquisition list for Beale Cipher key-text hunt. Priority buckets: A=Virginia/legal, B=Common law, C=School readers/biographies, D=Masonic, E=Popular literature available in 1820s Virginia.

entries.title: Commentaries on the Laws of England, Book 1: Rights of Persons
entries.author: William Blackstone
entries.notes: Most widely cited legal text in early America. Every Virginia lawyer owned a copy.

entries.title: Commentaries on the Laws of England, Book 2: Rights of Things
entries.author: William Blackstone
entries.notes: Property law — extremely relevant for a land/treasure context.

entries.title: Commentaries on the Laws of England, Book 3: Private Wrongs
entries.author: William Blackstone
entries.notes: Civil law volume.

entries.title: Commentaries on the Laws of England, Book 4: Public Wrongs
entries.author: William Blackstone
entries.notes: Criminal law volume.

entries.title: The Life of George Washington, Vol. 1
entries.author: John Marshall
entries.notes: By the Chief Justice. The definitive Washington biography of the era.

entries.title: The Life of George Washington, Vol. 2
entries.author: John Marshall
entries.notes: Volume 2 of Marshall's Life of Washington.

entries.title: The Life of George Washington, Vol. 3
entries.author: John Marshall
entries.notes: Volume 3 of Marshall's Life of Washington.

entries.title: The Life of George Washington, Vol. 4
entries.author: John Marshall
entries.notes: Volume 4 of Marshall's Life of Washington.

entries.title: The Life of George Washington, Vol. 5
entries.author: John Marshall
entries.notes: Volume 5 of Marshall's Life of Washington.

entries.title: The Vicar of Wakefield
entries.author: Oliver Goldsmith
entries.notes: Enormously popular novel in early America. Short enough to memorize key passages.

entries.title: The History of Rasselas, Prince of Abissinia
entries.author: Samuel Johnson
entries.notes: Very widely read moral tale. Available in 1820s Virginia.

entries.title: Ivanhoe: A Romance
entries.author: Sir Walter Scott
entries.notes: Massive bestseller in 1819. Contemporary with Beale. Scott was huge in Virginia.

entries.title: Rob Roy
entries.author: Sir Walter Scott
entries.notes: Another major Scott novel, published 1817.

entries.title: Waverley; Or, 'Tis Sixty Years Since
entries.author: Sir Walter Scott
entries.notes: Scott's first novel, extremely popular. Published anonymously.

entries.title: Don Juan
entries.author: Lord Byron
entries.notes: Byron's masterpiece, published 1819-1824. Poetry but very long.

entries.title: Childe Harold's Pilgrimage
entries.author: Lord Byron
entries.notes: Byron's famous narrative poem, 1812-1818.

entries.title: Letters from an American Farmer
entries.author: J. Hector St. John de Crevecoeur
entries.notes: Classic text on American identity. Well-known in Virginia.

entries.title: Gulliver's Travels
entries.author: Jonathan Swift
entries.notes: Universally known satire. Available in every bookshop.

entries.title: The Spectator (Addison & Steele essays)
entries.author: Joseph Addison and Richard Steele
entries.notes: Enormously influential essays, reprinted constantly. Very long compilation.

entries.title: The Spirit of the Laws
entries.author: Baron de Montesquieu
entries.notes: Foundational legal/political text. English translations widely available. May be French on Gutenberg.

entries.title: The Pioneers, or The Sources of the Susquehanna
entries.author: James Fenimore Cooper
entries.notes: Cooper's first Leatherstocking novel. Contemporary with Beale.

entries.title: The Sketch Book of Geoffrey Crayon, Gent.
entries.author: Washington Irving
entries.notes: Contains Rip Van Winkle + Legend of Sleepy Hollow. 1819-1820, hugely popular.

entries.title: The Life and Opinions of Tristram Shandy, Gentleman
entries.author: Laurence Sterne
entries.notes: Hugely popular 18th century novel, widely read in America.

entries.title: The History of Tom Jones, A Foundling
entries.author: Henry Fielding
entries.notes: Classic English novel, enormously popular in colonial/early America.

entries.title: The History of the Decline and Fall of the Roman Empire, Vol. 1
entries.author: Edward Gibbon
entries.notes: Gibbon's masterwork. Well-known to educated Americans. Vol 1.

entries.title: The History of England, Vol. 1
entries.author: David Hume
entries.notes: Hume's History was standard reading for educated Americans.

entries.title: The Freemason's Monitor, or Illustrations of Masonry
entries.author: Thomas Smith Webb
entries.notes: TODO: Search Internet Archive. The standard Masonic handbook in early America. HIGH PRIORITY for Beale (possible Freemason).

entries.title: The Constitutions of the Free-Masons
entries.author: James Anderson
entries.notes: TODO: Search Internet Archive / Google Books. Foundational Masonic document, republished many times.

entries.title: The Columbian Orator
entries.author: Caleb Bingham
entries.notes: TODO: Search Internet Archive. Major American school textbook. Frederick Douglass's schoolbook.

entries.title: A History of the Life and Death, Virtues and Exploits of General George Washington
entries.author: Mason Locke Weems
entries.notes: TODO: Search Internet Archive. Most popular biography in early America. 'Cherry tree' story origin.

entries.title: The American Geography, or A View of the Present Situation of the United States
entries.author: Jedidiah Morse
entries.notes: TODO: Search Internet Archive / Google Books. Standard American geography textbook.

entries.title: The History of Virginia
entries.author: John Daly Burk
entries.notes: TODO: Search Internet Archive. Virginia-specific history, 4 volumes, 1804-1816.

entries.title: The American Preceptor
entries.author: Caleb Bingham
entries.notes: TODO: Search Internet Archive. Widely used school reader. Companion to Columbian Orator.

entries.title: The American Spelling Book
entries.author: Noah Webster
entries.notes: TODO: Most printed book in America. May be too short for C1 but test for C3.

entries.title: Cato's Letters, or Essays on Liberty
entries.author: John Trenchard and Thomas Gordon
entries.notes: TODO: Search Internet Archive / Liberty Fund. Hugely influential on American founders.

entries.title: Memoirs of the Life of Benjamin Franklin (1818 edition)
entries.author: Benjamin Franklin / William Temple Franklin
entries.notes: 1818 London edition with correspondence. Different from the Autobiography.

entries.title: Emma
entries.author: Jane Austen
entries.notes: Published 1815. Austen was read in America by the 1820s.

entries.title: Pride and Prejudice
entries.author: Jane Austen
entries.notes: Published 1813. American editions from 1832 but earlier copies circulated.

entries.title: Thomas Jefferson's First Inaugural Address
entries.author: Thomas Jefferson
entries.notes: TODO: Short (~2500 words) but very well-known in Virginia. Test for C3.

entries.title: Clarissa, or, The History of a Young Lady
entries.author: Samuel Richardson
entries.notes: Longest English novel. Extremely well known. Richardson was huge in early America.

entries.title: Pamela; Or, Virtue Rewarded
entries.author: Samuel Richardson
entries.notes: First major English novel. Very widely read in colonial America.

entries.title: Captain Cook's Journal During the First Voyage Round the World
entries.author: James Cook
entries.notes: Adventure narrative. Beale and companions were adventurers heading west.

entries.title: The Journals of Lewis and Clark
entries.author: Meriwether Lewis and William Clark
entries.notes: Published 1814. Westward exploration narrative — relevant to Beale's journey west.

entries.title: A Manual of Parliamentary Practice
entries.author: Thomas Jefferson
entries.notes: Jefferson's rules of order. Well-known Virginia civic text.
